events.title: ESL Classes with Evergreen Valley College (EVC) - ESL 501: Reading & Writing 1

cases.refreshed: Develop your English language skills by practicing speaking, listening, reading, writing, vocabulary, pronunciation, and grammar. ESL 501 Reading & Writing 1 is a free, noncredit course for high-beginning English learners. It focuses on basic reading, writing, grammar, and vocabulary. Students will learn to comprehend frequently used words in context, use learned phrases and sentences to express ideas in basic writing, understand basic grammar structures, and read simplified material. Course Information: Starts: August 25, 2026; Ends: December 10, 2026; Meeting Days: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday; Time: 10:30 AM - 12:30 PM; Instructor: Michelle N. Henninger. Before the classes start, you must complete a Guided Self-Placement (GSP). This is not a test—it's simply an assessment to help us place you in the most appropriate ESL class based on your current English level. We will assist you with the application and registration process in person at the Edenvale Branch Library. Space is limited.
cases.reviewed: ESL 501 Reading & Writing 1 is a free, noncredit course for learners at the high-beginning English level. It focuses on basic reading, writing, grammar, and vocabulary, with practice in speaking, listening, and pronunciation. Students learn the meanings of common words in context, express ideas in writing using familiar phrases and sentences, understand basic grammar structures, and read simplified texts. The course runs from August 25, 2026, through December 10, 2026. Classes meet Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday from 10:30 AM to 12:30 PM. The instructor is Michelle N. Henninger. Complete the Guided Self-Placement assessment before classes start. It helps the college place you in a class for your English level. Get help applying and registering in person at Edenvale Branch Library. Space is limited.

events.title: Connect with your Community Resource Navigator
Connect with your Community Resource Navigator

cases.refreshed: Looking for community resources or not sure where to start? Stop by Milpitas Library and meet Evelyn, your Community Resource Navigator, at our information table! Evelyn can help you explore resources and connect with services related to housing, food assistance, public benefits, employment, and more. Stop by our information table to ask questions, learn more about the program, or schedule an individual appointment for additional support. To learn more about the Community Resource Navigator program and explore services available at our other libraries, visit: Community Resource Navigators | Santa Clara County Library District
